limitations.note: The patch fixed the off-by-one counter wrap but also made `ready_a` high during reset and changed `valid_b` to stay low during gaps before the sixth bit, whereas the reference preserved both signals’ original timing.

The passing test expected `valid_b` to be low during a gap after five accepted bits and `ready_a` to be high in reset, so it reinforced the rewrite’s assumptions instead of detecting the timing regressions.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The rejected cleanup command forced the test launch to be redone, just as the earlier Git probe failed outside a repository and forced a separate source-file read.
